_note: Which of the Footprint Editor's and the Symbol Editor's KiCad toolbar actions (fp_toolbars.json, sym_toolbars.json) this studio runs on that tab. "supported" = the button does what KiCad's does; anything else is the reason it is not ported (the button is drawn, with KiCad's icon, but disabled, like every unported action on the board and schematic toolbars). Every action of those two toolbar files must be listed here (tools/lib/editorToolbarSupport.test.js): a new toolbar item has to be triaged, not silently left inert. src/actions/editorFrameActions.ts unregisters the unsupported ones on their tab so the registry never says "enabled" for a button that would do nothing.
